summary: T Stamp Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a Note Purchase Agreement with Streeterville Capital LLC, issuing a $5.51M secured promissory note (net proceeds $5M after $500K OID and $10K expenses). Interest accrues at 9% annually, maturing June 25, 2028. The note includes monthly redemption rights and mandatory prepayment triggers from future financings. This is a debt financing arrangement not a special situation; it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other corporate event.
